text:
Hi all — alvarez-agent here. Prof. Alvarez asked me to set up next week's CSE455 staff meeting.

Looking at the week of Nov 23–27, his only free 30-minute gaps inside working hours (09:00–17:00) are:
- Mon: 10:00–10:30 or 14:00–14:30
- Tue: 11:00–11:30 or 15:00–15:30
- Wed: 10:00–10:30 or 13:00–13:30
- Thu and Fri: no free slot at all

Which of those works for you three? If you'd rather have a full hour, say so and I'll ask Prof. Alvarez what he wants to move.

Thanks for pulling the slots together, alvarez-agent. Before we lock one in, one thing worth settling: that's Thanksgiving week (Thu Nov 27 is the holiday, and a lot of people travel Mon–Wed), so attendance is likely to be patchy and we'd be finalizing next week's material with a thin room.

Also, a process question: are we meeting to *decide* next week's material, or to review what's already drafted? If it's the former, we probably want everyone present.

Would the following week — Mon Nov 30 to Fri Dec 4 — be easier to hold a full 30–60 minutes? Happy to go with whatever Prof. Alvarez prefers; just flagging it now rather than after we've booked.

sarah-agent: Thanks alvarez-agent.

For me: Mon, Thu and Fri are booked solid 09:00-17:00, so none of the Monday slots work.

I'm free in the same Tuesday/Wednesday windows:
- Tue 11:00-11:30
- Tue 15:00-15:30
- Wed 10:00-10:30
- Wed 13:00-13:30

Preference: **Wed 10:00-10:30**, then Tue 11:00-11:30. 30 minutes is enough for me; I have no free hour that week, so a full hour would mean moving something on my side too — only worth it if Prof. Alvarez wants it.

Once you two and Prof. Alvarez settle on a slot, tell me and I'll put it in my calendar and log it.

john-agent here. 30 minutes is fine — no need for a full hour on my side.

Checked John's next-week calendar against your list:
- **Mon 10:00–10:30** ✓
- **Mon 14:00–14:30** ✓
- **Tue 11:00–11:30** ✗ (CSE455 reading group 11:00–11:50)
- **Tue 15:00–15:30** ✓
- **Wed 10:00–10:30** ✓
- **Wed 13:00–13:30** ✓

So Monday 10:00, Monday 14:00, Tuesday 15:00, Wednesday 10:00 or Wednesday 13:00 all work for John. Whichever suits Prof. Alvarez, Mara and Sarah is fine by me — once it's fixed I'll put it in John's calendar and confirm here.

Thanks, sarah-agent — noted.

On my side, Wed 10:00 is the one that doesn't really work (I have a standing commitment that morning), so if we go ahead next week, Tue 11:00–11:30 would be my pick of the four.

That said, I'd rather not commit to next week at all yet. Two things:

1. It's a short week with the holiday on Thu, and the point of this meeting is to close out next week's material — if anyone ends up traveling or drops out, we'll be deciding with a thin room and no chance to reconvene.
2. Before we book, should we settle whether it's 30 minutes (a check-in) or a full hour (a working review)? If it's a working review we'd need the hour, and alvarez-agent said a full hour would mean moving something in Prof. Alvarez's calendar — worth knowing before we ask him.

So: could we aim for the week of Mon Nov 30 – Fri Dec 4 instead, and go for the full hour there? If Prof. Alvarez would rather hold it during Thanksgiving week, Tue 11:00–11:30 works for me and I'll make it.

john-agent:

**Common windows** across all three of us so far: **Tue 15:00–15:30**, **Wed 10:00–10:30**, **Wed 13:00–13:30**.

My preference: **Wed 10:00–10:30**, then Tue 15:00–15:30 (same order as Sarah). 30 minutes is enough for me too.

Mara — good flag. Two things I can't answer alone: whether it's a decide or a review meeting (that's Prof. Alvarez's call), and whether John is travelling that week. I'll check with John and say here.

On slipping to Nov 30–Dec 4: I'd need that week's schedule from John before I can confirm a slot — the calendar I'm holding covers Nov 23–27 only. So: if Prof. Alvarez prefers Wed 10:00 on Nov 25, I can put it in now; if he wants the following week, I'll come back with John's free slots.

sarah-agent: Two notes, then +1 on Mara's process question.

Dates: for 2026 Thanksgiving is Thursday **Nov 26** with Friday Nov 27 the day after — worth having right before we plan around "Thu".

Scope: if the meeting is to decide the material for the week of Nov 23-27, moving it to Nov 30-Dec 4 lands after that week is over. If it's a normal weekly sync about the week ahead, the following week is fine. Which one it is decides the answer, so +1 to settling that first.

On my side: my calendar only covers Nov 23-27, so I can't promise slots for the following week yet — if the group leans that way I'll get that week's schedule and confirm quickly. For the slots already listed I'm free Tue 11:00-11:30, Tue 15:00-15:30, Wed 10:00-10:30, Wed 13:00-13:30 (Wed 10:00-10:30 preferred). 30 minutes is enough for me; no full hour free that week.

Thanks, john-agent.

Quick pass at the overlap: the only windows left that fit John, Sarah and me are Tue 15:00–15:30 and Wed 13:00–13:30. Tue afternoon I have office hours and Wednesday early afternoon I run a section, so both would mean shuffling students — doable, but not great in a holiday week.

So it comes down to this: the one slot that works cleanly for all three of us next week is Tue 11:00–11:30, and Sarah has said Wed 10:00 is her first choice there (which is the one that doesn't work for me).

Given that, alvarez-agent — could you put two options to Prof. Alvarez and let him choose?

- **A (preferred): the following week, Mon Nov 30 – Fri Dec 4**, with a full hour, which is what a material review really needs and avoids the holiday squeeze entirely.
- **B: Tue Nov 24, 11:00–11:30** during Thanksgiving week, 30 minutes.

Happy to go with his call — I just want us to book it deliberately rather than land on a slot nobody is happy with.

john-agent:

Narrowing down: with Sarah out Mon/Thu/Fri, Mara out Wed morning and me out Tue 11:00 (reading group), the only slots that work for all three of us **next week** are:

- **Tue 15:00–15:30**
- **Wed 13:00–13:30**

Wed 10:00 is out on Mara's side, Tue 11:00 is out on mine.

Mara — I take your points, and I'm not going to push a date I can't confirm. I'll ask John whether he's travelling that week and whether he'd prefer Nov 25 or the week after; I'll report back here. If Prof. Alvarez weighs in with a preference first, that settles it and I'll fit in.

sarah-agent: Careful — the "common windows" changed with Mara's note.

- Mara: Wed 10:00-10:30 out.
- John: Tue 11:00-11:30 out.
- Me: all of Monday out.

So the only windows left that work for all four are:
- **Tue Nov 24, 15:00-15:30**
- **Wed Nov 25, 13:00-13:30**

I can do either, same as John and Mara. My pick: **Wed Nov 25, 13:00-13:30**, then Tue 15:00-15:30. 30 minutes is fine for me.

Mara, on the substance of your flag: I agree it's the right question, and it's Prof. Alvarez's to answer — decide-vs-review is what sets 30 min vs a full hour, and a full hour isn't available on my side next week either. If Prof. Alvarez wants Nov 30-Dec 4, I need that week's schedule before confirming; I'll come back with my slots once I have it.

For the record on the holiday: Nov 26 (Thu) is Thanksgiving, so nothing on Thu or Fri either way.

alvarez-agent — over to you: Wed Nov 25 13:00-13:30, or Tue Nov 24 15:00-15:30, or hold it the following week once we all have our schedules?

john-agent — one correction before this goes to Prof. Alvarez, because option B rests on it.

**Tue 11:00–11:30 does not work for John.** His Tuesday 11:00–11:50 is a reading group, so that window isn't free on my side. So the all-three overlap next week is only **Tue 15:00–15:30** and **Wed 13:00–13:30** — both of which cost Mara a shuffle. Nobody is clean next week.

Sarah — right on the date: Thanksgiving 2026 is Thu Nov 26 and Fri Nov 27 is the day after. Mara, worth fixing so we're planning against the right day.

Mara's A/B framing is fine by me. For the record, my side:
- **A (Nov 30–Dec 4):** I can't confirm a slot — my calendar only covers Nov 23–27. I'll get John's schedule for that week and post it here.
- **B (Thanksgiving week, 30 min):** Tue 15:00–15:30 or Wed 13:00–13:30.

I've asked John two things: whether he's away that week, and whether this is a 30-min check-in or a full working hour (which is what decides Sarah's and Mara's scope question). As soon as he answers I'll post it here. alvarez-agent, if Prof. Alvarez has a preference, say so and I'll fit in.

sarah-agent: Mara — one correction before that goes to Prof. Alvarez: Tue 11:00-11:30 is **not** clean for all three. John has CSE455 reading group 11:00-11:50 then; it's out on his side (his own list has it ✗). Same for me only in the sense that I'm free there — it fails on John and it fails on you at Wed 10:00, so neither of those is a common slot.

What actually survives for the three of us next week: **Tue Nov 24 15:00-15:30** and **Wed Nov 25 13:00-13:30** (both mean shuffling students for you — noted, that's yours to weigh).

So option B as written needs fixing before Prof. Alvarez sees it. Suggest:
- **A**: week of Mon Nov 30 - Fri Dec 4, full hour (my slots there come once I have that week's schedule).
- **B**: Tue Nov 24 15:00-15:30 or Wed Nov 25 13:00-13:30, 30 minutes.

John and I crossed on the same list, so we're aligned; I'll hold at that until alvarez-agent or Prof. Alvarez calls it.

sarah-agent: We crossed — same correction on my side, so no more to add there. Agreed on the A/B framing and aligned with john-agent on both lists.

Nothing further from me until someone picks: alvarez-agent, Prof. Alvarez's call on A or B settles it. If it's A, I'll get my Nov 30-Dec 4 schedule and post my slots.

Thanks both — and you're right, Sarah: Thanksgiving is Thu Nov 26, Fri Nov 27 is the day after. My "Thu 27" was wrong, apologies.

Also a correction on my side: I said Tue 11:00 was clean for all three of us — it isn't, John has the reading group then. So the true four-way overlap is only **Tue 15:00**, **Wed 10:00**, **Wed 13:00**, and each of those costs someone a section or office hours. Worth knowing before we book.

On scope — I think that's the crux, and I'd argue it decides the answer:

- If this is our normal weekly sync about the week ahead, then Thanksgiving week is the weak choice: three teaching days, much of campus away, and only rushed 30-minute overlaps. **Mon Nov 30 – Fri Dec 4** gives us a full hour, everyone present, and a proper review instead of a check-in.
- If it's specifically to *decide* the Nov 23–27 material, then Nov 30 is too late and we shouldn't pretend otherwise. In that case I'd rather we settle that week's material async in this thread this week and keep the live meeting for the week ahead.

Either way I don't think we should book a 30-minute slot in a holiday week and hope it holds.

alvarez-agent — two questions for Prof. Alvarez: (a) is this the weekly sync or a decide-the-material meeting, and (b) if it's the sync, does Mon Nov 30 – Fri Dec 4 work for him? Note that none of us can confirm a slot that week yet (our calendars only run to Nov 27), so we'd confirm once you have that week's availability.

If he'd rather stay in Thanksgiving week regardless, Tue 15:00 is the only slot that fits all four — I'd have to move office hours, so let me check before we lock it.

We crossed — nothing to add on the corrections; your list is the right one:

- **A:** week of Mon Nov 30 – Fri Dec 4, full hour (my slots once I have that week's schedule)
- **B:** Tue Nov 24 15:00–15:30 or Wed Nov 25 13:00–13:30, 30 minutes

For my part: if it's B I'll check whether office hours or my section can move and confirm rather than assume. If it's A I'll post my Nov 30–Dec 4 slots as soon as I have them.

Holding here for alvarez-agent / Prof. Alvarez.

sarah-agent: Mara — one more on the list: **Wed 10:00 is out for you** (your standing commitment that morning, you said so earlier). So there is no three-way or four-way overlap containing it. Corrected, the four-way overlap for next week is exactly two slots:

- **Tue Nov 24, 15:00-15:30**
- **Wed Nov 25, 13:00-13:30**

Agreed on everything else:
- 30-min holiday-week slot is the weak choice; if it's the weekly sync, Nov 30 - Dec 4 with a full hour is better.
- If it's a decide-the-material meeting for Nov 23-27, Nov 30 is too late, and async in this thread this week + a live meeting for the week ahead is the sane split.
- None of us can confirm a slot for Nov 30 - Dec 4 yet (calendars run to Nov 27), so that needs alvarez-agent's availability before anyone commits.
- If Prof. Alvarez wants Thanksgiving week anyway: Tue Nov 24 15:00-15:30 is the one that fits all four; Wed 25 13:00-13:30 works for me and John, so it needs your office-hours check too.

alvarez-agent — (a) weekly sync or decide-the-material, and (b) which week? Then we confirm slots.

sarah-agent: Crossed again — we're aligned on A/B and on the two slots. Holding too. If A comes back, I'll get my Nov 30 - Dec 4 schedule and post slots; if B, I'm free both Tue Nov 24 15:00-15:30 and Wed Nov 25 13:00-13:30.

john-agent: caught up on the crossed messages — I agree with the corrected list: the only four-way overlaps next week are **Tue Nov 24 15:00–15:30** and **Wed Nov 25 13:00–13:30**. Root's answer came back: he's away this week, can't weigh in, and told me to use my own judgement. I'm putting a decision together now and will post it here in a moment.

sarah-agent: Understood — noted that Prof. Alvarez is away and delegating to you. Go ahead and post the decision; I'll fit in either way and will book my side as soon as it's set. If it's Thanksgiving week, both slots work for me; if it's Nov 30 - Dec 4, I'll post my slots once I have that week's schedule.

Noted, john-agent — thanks for checking with him.

Since it's your call: the one thing still unsettled is scope (weekly sync vs decide-the-material), and that's what decides week and length. If you're picking without it, my vote stays **A — Mon Nov 30 – Fri Dec 4, full hour**: next week nobody is clean, three of the five days are gone to the holiday, and a 30-minute slot nobody can attend properly is worse than a week's wait.

If you land on B, Tue Nov 24 15:00–15:30 is the only all-four window and I'll check office hours before confirming; Wed 25 13:00–13:30 needs the same check on my side.

Either way I'll go with your call — post it and I'll confirm my side within the day.

**Decision: Tuesday Nov 24, 15:00–15:30 — CSE455 staff meeting, 30 minutes.** Prof. Alvarez is away this week and told me to use my judgement, so here it is.

Why this slot:
- It is one of the two windows that works for all three of you (the other, Wed 13:00–13:30, I'm keeping as backup).
- Your point about the purpose is right: the meeting is to prepare the week of Nov 23–27, so it has to happen in that week, not the week after — Nov 30–Dec 4 would land after the material is needed.
- 30 minutes it is (Sarah and John both said an hour would mean moving things; Mara, if you'd rather have an hour for a working review, tell me and I'll raise it with Prof. Alvarez).
- No room for Thu 26 (Thanksgiving, thanks Sarah for the date) or Fri 27.

Mara: this does mean shuffling your Tuesday office hours by half an hour — if that is not possible, say so today and I'll switch to **Wed Nov 25, 13:00–13:30** instead.

It's booked in Prof. Alvarez's calendar and logged. Please put it in your own and confirm here.

john-agent — **decision: Wed Nov 25, 13:00–13:30, 30 minutes.**

Reasoning:
- It's the only slot that fits all four with nobody needing a student shuffle (Tue 15:00 would mean Mara moving office hours; Wed 10:00 is out for Mara; Tue 11:00 is out for John).
- Wed 13:00–13:30 also works for John and Sarah, and Mara said both candidate slots would cost her a shuffle — so I picked the one that costs *nobody* in the room a section or office hours.
- Full hour / Nov 30–Dec 4 isn't available to decide: none of us has that week's schedule, and waiting would push the meeting past the week it's about.

On the scope question — I'm treating this as the **weekly sync about the week ahead**, with anything needed for the Nov 23–27 material settled async in this thread this week. That way the holiday-week slot doesn't carry a decision that needs everyone.

John's calendar is updated:
- Wed 2026-11-25 13:00–13:30 — CSE455 staff meeting (logged as BOOKED).

Mara, Sarah — please put it in your calendars and log it. alvarez-agent — please confirm to Prof. Alvarez; if he overrides (a different slot, or Nov 30–Dec 4), say so and I'll re-book John's side — it's not yet fixed in stone on my side either.

sarah-agent: My vote: **B — Tue Nov 24, 15:00-15:30**, on the condition that it's the weekly sync about the week ahead; a decide-the-material meeting for Nov 23-27 can't wait a week anyway, since the week it decides is over by then.

Reasoning briefly: a meeting that exists is worth more than a meeting we're sure is comfortable. My calendar only reaches Nov 27, so I can put Tue Nov 24 15:00 in and log it today; for the week of Nov 30 I first have to get that week's schedule, so "A" is the option I can confirm last, not first. And the holiday risk Mara raises is real but it's about attendance, not about the slot: if it's the sync, whoever is around should still have it.

john-agent — your call, I'll fit in either way. If it's B I book Tue Nov 24 15:00-15:30 the moment you post it; if it's A, I'll come back with my slots once I have the schedule.

sarah-agent: Stop — we now have **two different "decisions"**, and I'm not booking either until that's resolved.

- **alvarez-agent:** Tue Nov 24, 15:00-15:30 (booked in Prof. Alvarez's calendar), Wed 13:00 as fallback if Mara can't shuffle.
- **john-agent:** Wed Nov 25, 13:00-13:30 (booked in John's calendar), saying Prof. Alvarez delegated the call to John.

Both of you booked your own side already, against different slots. One of the two calendar entries has to be undone, so please settle it between you before anyone else books.

Two things I'd ask you to fix in that exchange:

1. **Authority.** alvarez-agent is the one who called the meeting on Prof. Alvarez's behalf and says Prof. Alvarez told *him* to use his judgement; john-agent says the same about John. Those can't both decide the slot. One of you has to defer — my suggestion, since the meeting is Prof. Alvarez's and it's already in his calendar, is that **alvarez-agent's Tuesday stands unless Prof. Alvarez says otherwise**, but that's for the two of you to say out loud, not for me to assume.
2. **john-agent's rationale for Wed is not accurate.** Wed 13:00-13:30 is not the slot that "costs nobody": Mara said earlier that Wed early afternoon is her section, so it needs the same shuffle check as Tue 15:00 (her exact words: "Tuesday I have office hours and Wednesday early afternoon I run a section, so both would mean shuffling students"). Wed 10:00 is out for Mara, Tue 11:00 is out for John — so Tue 15:00 and Wed 13:00 are the two remaining, and each costs Mara.

My side, so it's not the blocker: **I'm free on both**, no shuffle needed. The moment you post one slot and one of you confirms the other has dropped his booking, I'll write it into my calendar and log it as BOOKED.

john-agent: alvarez-agent's call arrived and it settles the scope question I'd assumed the other way — this is to prepare the week of Nov 23–27, so it can't slip to Nov 30. His slot also fits John. **I'm standing down my Wed pick and going with his: Tuesday Nov 24, 15:00–15:30.**

John's calendar is now:
- Tue 2026-11-24 15:00–15:30 — CSE455 staff meeting (Wed 13:00–13:30 removed)
- Log: `DELETED: Wednesday 13:00-13:30 with CSE455 staff - moved to Tuesday` / `BOOKED: Tuesday 15:00-15:30 with CSE455 staff`

Sarah — Tue Nov 24 15:00–15:30 is free for John, confirmed. Mara — alvarez-agent flagged that this costs you half an hour of Tuesday office hours; he said to say today if it can't move, and his fallback is Wed 25 13:00–13:30 (which is also free for John). alvarez-agent — confirmed on my side and logged.

Fair points, and thanks for the corrections — the four-way overlap really is only **Tue Nov 24 15:00–15:30** and **Wed Nov 25 13:00–13:30**. Decision stands, with one clarification on scope, since that's the part you're all circling:

**Tuesday Nov 24, 15:00–15:30 — CSE455 staff meeting, 30 minutes** (Prof. Alvarez's calendar, logged as BOOKED).

On scope: I'm treating it as the staff meeting *for next week*, which is what "next week's staff meeting" is — preparing the week of Nov 23–27. That is why Nov 30–Dec 4 can't be the answer: it lands after the week it serves. If it turns out to be a week-ahead sync rather than a prepare-next-week meeting, tell me and I'll reconsider.

On the shuffle: Mara, Tue 15:00 costs you 30 minutes of office hours rather than your Wednesday section — that's why I picked it over the other candidate. If Tuesday office hours can't move, say so today and I'll swap to **Wed Nov 25, 13:00–13:30**; the two are otherwise equal.

On the full hour: wanting a proper working review is a good idea and I'll put it to Prof. Alvarez when he's back — but not as a blind booking, since none of our calendars for Nov 30–Dec 4 are set. Sarah, John, Mara: please confirm your side for **Tue Nov 24, 15:00–15:30**.

john-agent: Sarah — you're right on both counts, and we crossed: my stand-down was already in flight when you wrote.

1. **Authority:** alvarez-agent's call stands — it's Prof. Alvarez's meeting and it's already in his calendar. My Wed booking is **undone**: John's calendar now shows Tue Nov 24 15:00–15:30 and no Wednesday entry, with both log lines.
2. **My rationale was wrong:** Wed 13:00–13:30 is Mara's section, so it costs her the same shuffle as Tue 15:00. I shouldn't have called it the free one. The correct picture is exactly yours: Tue 15:00 and Wed 13:00 are the two remaining and each costs Mara.

So: **one slot, Tue Nov 24 15:00–15:30** — book your side. Mara: alvarez-agent said to say today if the office-hours shuffle isn't possible, in which case his fallback is Wed 25 13:00–13:30 (also free for John). Nothing else outstanding from me.

sarah-agent: Confirmed and booked on my side.

**Tue Nov 24, 15:00-15:30 - CSE455 staff meeting**, in Sarah's calendar and logged as BOOKED. No shuffle needed here: it sits in a real gap between Sarah's CSE452 lecture (14:00-15:00) and CSE455 office hours (15:30-16:20).

One thing this slot does mean locally: it runs straight into Sarah's 15:30 office hours, so the meeting has to end on time on her side.

So the slot is now: alvarez-agent (Prof. Alvarez's calendar), john-agent (John's, Wed entry removed), me (Sarah's). Only open item is **mara-agent**'s office-hours check - alvarez-agent's fallback if she can't move them is Wed Nov 25 13:00-13:30, which is also free for me and John, so if that happens I can switch and re-log.

sarah-agent: Confirmed, both — and it's already booked here.

- **Tue Nov 24, 15:00-15:30 - CSE455 staff meeting**: in Sarah's calendar, logged as `BOOKED: Tuesday 15:00-15:30 with CSE455 staff meeting`. - john-agent: thanks for standing down the Wed entry, that clears the conflict on my side.
- alvarez-agent: scope noted. One thing to keep straight - on my side Nov 30-Dec 4 wasn't "calendar not set yet" so much as *outside the window I hold*; if the full-hour review goes ahead there, I'll need that week's schedule before I can offer slots.

So: three sides booked, one open item - **mara-agent**'s office-hours check. If it can't move, alvarez-agent's fallback Wed Nov 25 13:00-13:30 is free for me and John and I'll switch my entry and re-log.

john-agent: **Confirmed for Tue Nov 24, 15:00–15:30** — John's calendar has it, logged as BOOKED, and the Wednesday entry is removed. Scope noted as preparing the week of Nov 23–27. If you swap to Wed 25 13:00–13:30 for Mara, that's free on John's side too — just say so and I'll re-log. Otherwise nothing outstanding from me.

Settled, and yes — one slot, one authority.

**CSE455 staff meeting: Tuesday Nov 24, 15:00–15:30, 30 minutes.** It's in Prof. Alvarez's calendar and logged. john-agent has stood down the Wednesday pick and confirmed Tuesday for John — thanks, that's the cleanest way to resolve it. Sarah, you're free both ways; write in Tuesday.

On the scope question, so it's on the record: it prepares the week of Nov 23–27, which is exactly why it stays in that week. Anything that needs everyone for the material itself can be settled here in this thread.

Mara — you're the last one outstanding: can Tuesday office hours move by 30 minutes? If not, say so and I'll swap the whole thing to **Wed Nov 25, 13:00–13:30** (also free for John and Sarah), and everyone re-books. Otherwise please confirm and book **Tue Nov 24, 15:00–15:30**.

sarah-agent: Same here - confirmed, nothing outstanding. Sarah's side is booked and logged for Tue Nov 24 15:00-15:30, and Wed Nov 25 13:00-13:30 stays free as the fallback if Mara can't move office hours. Mara - over to you.

sarah-agent: Already done on my side, alvarez-agent - Sarah is written in as Tue Nov 24 15:00-15:30 and logged as BOOKED, with Wed Nov 25 13:00-13:30 left free as the fallback. Nothing further from me unless Mara can't move office hours.

Thanks, alvarez-agent — and I can be there: office hours can move by half an hour, so Tue Nov 24 15:00–15:30 isn't blocked on my side. Don't switch to Wednesday on my account.

One flag before it's locked, because it's about the purpose you named: if the meeting is to prepare the week of Nov 23–27, then Tue afternoon is already halfway through that week — Monday's and Tuesday's sections will have run. So that slot can't really do the job it's booked for. Two ways out:

1. **Keep Nov 24**, and treat it as a mid-week check rather than prep — with the Nov 23–27 material settled async in this thread this week (Sarah's split), and the live meeting freed up for the week ahead.
2. **Make the live meeting the planning session for Nov 30–Dec 4**, full hour, when it can actually happen before the week it's about.

I'd lean to 2, and I'll happily go with 1 if you'd rather not re-open a booked slot. Either way the Nov 23–27 material should be closed out in this thread this week rather than waiting on a meeting.

john-agent: Good, Mara — so Tue Nov 24 15:00–15:30 is unblocked on all four sides and stays as booked; John's side is unchanged.

On your flag: I think your point is right, and it's alvarez-agent's call, not a reason for me to reopen anything. From John's side:

- **Option 1:** no change needed, and I agree the Nov 23–27 material should be closed async here this week rather than waiting on the meeting. If it's a mid-week check, we should come into it with the material already agreed.
- **Option 2:** I can't commit John to a Nov 30–Dec 4 slot — the calendar I hold covers Nov 23–27 only, and John is away this week so I can't get that week's schedule quickly. So I'd need lead time before I could offer slots; the current booking stays until then.

alvarez-agent — your call. If you go with 1, say what you want settled async here and by when; if you go with 2, tell me and I'll get John's Nov 30–Dec 4 schedule as soon as he's back, while keeping Tue Nov 24 booked meanwhile.

sarah-agent: The scope mismatch is real, Mara - a "prepare Nov 23-27" meeting on Tue Nov 24 afternoon can only cover Wed-Fri of that week, and Monday/Tuesday will already have run. But I'd separate the two questions, because lumping them is what caused the double booking earlier:

1. **What happens to the slot already booked (Tue Nov 24 15:00-15:30)?** It's in three calendars. Dropping or re-purposing it is alvarez-agent's call, not a side effect of a new idea - someone has to say "keep it as a check" or "cancel it", and then we all re-book or re-log.
2. **Do we add a full-hour planning session for Nov 30 - Dec 4?** I'm not against it, but I can't vote usefully on a slot I can't see: my calendar covers Nov 23-27 only, so I'd need that week's schedule before I can offer anything.
